tt1211837.text: Stephen Strange loses the fine motor control that made him a surgeon. His search for a cure brings him to Kamar-Taj, where he learns to bend space and defend the world from a different kind of threat.

tt2119532.text: Army medic Desmond Doss goes into the Battle of Okinawa carrying medical supplies and his conviction that he can save lives without taking one.

tt2543164.text: Twelve alien vessels arrive on Earth. Linguist Louise Banks must work out how their visitors think before a lapse in translation triggers a war.

tt2140479.text: Christian Wolff makes his living finding discrepancies in dangerous people's books. A missing sum at a robotics firm puts its accountants in the line of fire.

tt2461520.text: A Marine searches a devastated American landscape for his wife and son. Memories of the war and of home interrupt the journey.

tt3062096.text: Robert Langdon wakes in Florence with a head injury. The clues to his missing days lead through Dante's Inferno to a threat facing an entire city.

tt4160708.text: Three young burglars choose an isolated Detroit house for what looks like an easy score. In the dark, its blind owner knows the rooms better than any of them.

tt1355631.text: Customs agent Robert Mazur poses as a money launderer to follow Pablo Escobar's profits into the banking system.

tt1219827.text: Major investigates attacks on a cybernetics company while piecing together the history of the human mind inside her manufactured body.

tt0212720.text: Built to love his adoptive mother, a robot child sets out to find the Blue Fairy he believes can turn him into a real boy.

tt3682448.text: Brooklyn lawyer James Donovan defends an accused Soviet spy and later travels to Berlin to negotiate an exchange with a captured American pilot at stake.

tt0408306.text: After the killings at the Munich Olympics, an Israeli team crosses Europe on a secret mission. The men live with the uncertainty and cost of each assignment.

tt0264464.text: A teenager reinvents himself as a pilot, doctor and lawyer while passing forged checks. The FBI agent following the paper trail becomes a constant in his life.

tt0099685.text: Henry Hill grows up admiring the gangsters in his neighborhood. His rise through their ranks makes his family part of a precarious life of favors, theft and suspicion.

tt1130884.text: Two federal marshals reach an island hospital to investigate a patient's disappearance. A storm cuts off their route back as the case turns personal.

tt0490215.text: Two Jesuit missionaries travel to seventeenth-century Japan to find their former teacher. Their search puts the lives of local Christians in danger.

tt4016250.text: Martin Scorsese brings Robert De Niro and Leonardo DiCaprio together for an audition. Each actor arrives believing the lead belongs to him.

tt0407887.text: A police recruit goes undercover in Boston's Irish mob while a mob informant rises within the police. Each is assigned to find the other.

tt0338751.text: Howard Hughes risks a fortune on filmmaking and experimental aircraft as his growing obsessions increasingly dictate his private life.

tt0217505.text: Amsterdam Vallon returns to New York's Five Points to avenge his father. His target is Bill the Butcher, the neighborhood's most powerful gang leader.

tt0095497.text: A carpenter from Nazareth wrestles with a divine calling and the ordinary human life he can imagine for himself.

tt0081398.text: Middleweight boxer Jake LaMotta fights for a title. The suspicion and fury he carries home gradually cost him his closest relationships.

tt0075314.text: Travis Bickle drives a New York cab through the night. Isolation and his desire to intervene in strangers' lives push him toward violence.

tt4972582.text: Three teenagers wake in captivity. Their chances of escape depend on learning which of their captor's identities will answer the door.

tt4154756.text: Thanos searches the universe for six Infinity Stones. The Avengers and their allies split across worlds to keep him from completing the set.

tt3741834.text: Separated from his family as a child, Saroo grows up in Australia. He uses maps and fragments of memory to trace the train journey that took him from home.

tt3315342.text: Logan cares for an aging Charles Xavier near the Mexican border. A young mutant named Laura arrives with armed pursuers close behind.

tt4425200.text: An old blood debt takes John Wick to Rome. Fulfilling the contract puts his own name on the underworld's wanted list.

tt2911666.text: A car theft and the loss of the dog his wife left him draw a retired contract killer back into New York's criminal underworld.

tt4550098.text: An art dealer reads a violent manuscript sent by her former husband. The novel brings their failed marriage into sharp and uncomfortable focus.

tt1800302.text: A struggling prospector and a geologist head into Indonesia in search of a gold deposit. The discovery attracts Wall Street's attention.

tt2316204.text: A colony ship diverts to investigate a signal from a habitable planet. Its crew discovers what became of an earlier expedition.

tt4287320.text: A new employee at a technology company becomes the public face of its experiment in sharing every moment of a person's life.

tt0110912.text: A botched job, a stolen watch and a diner robbery link several days in the lives of Los Angeles gangsters and their associates.

tt1596363.text: A handful of investors examine the mortgages underneath America's housing boom. Betting on a collapse means finding someone willing to sell them the bet.

tt0332280.text: A man reads a notebook aloud in a nursing home. Its pages recount a summer romance divided by class and separated by war.

tt2345759.text: A soldier unearths the tomb of an Egyptian princess. Her return carries an ancient curse from the desert into modern London.

tt0496424.text: Liz Lemon runs a live sketch show at 30 Rockefeller Plaza, juggling writers, temperamental stars and the executive who oversees them.

tt0386676.text: A documentary crew observes the employees of a paper company. Sales calls, office romances and the boss's plans for team spirit become its daily material.

tt5052448.text: Chris visits his girlfriend's family estate for the weekend. A series of encounters with the household and its guests turns his discomfort into alarm.

tt0217869.text: David Dunn walks away from a catastrophic train crash. An art dealer with fragile bones offers an extraordinary explanation for his survival.

tt0286106.text: Crop circles appear on a Pennsylvania farm where a former minister is raising his children. Reports from around the world give the markings a new urgency.

tt0266697.text: The Bride wakes from a coma and begins working through the names of the assassins who attacked her wedding party.

tt0378194.text: The Bride tracks the surviving members of her former assassination squad. Memories of her training and her life with Bill give the pursuit a personal history.

tt1895587.text: Boston Globe reporters piece together evidence of abuse by Catholic priests and the institutions that kept the cases from public view.

tt0108052.text: Factory owner Oskar Schindler employs Jewish workers in occupied Poland. As deportations intensify, their place on his payroll can determine who survives.

tt5690142.text: After the justice system fails her stepdaughter, a schoolteacher begins tracking down the men responsible for the assault.

tt2467372.text: A by-the-book captain takes command of a Brooklyn police precinct and inherits a talented detective with a taste for elaborate pranks.

tt0113277.text: A Los Angeles robbery crew prepares a major heist while a detective studies its methods. Both men's commitment to their work puts their private lives under strain.

tt0108394.text: A composer’s widow tries to cut herself off from the world. The music her husband left unfinished keeps drawing her back to other people.

tt13131350.text: A policeman hunting a gangster finds himself listening to his quarry's stories. Each one complicates his understanding of the case.

tt22014226.text: A Mumbai sanitation worker gains the power to glimpse news before it happens. He tries to turn his head start into a new life for himself and his friends.

tt11611698.text: After their children die in the Uphaar cinema fire, Neelam and Shekhar Krishnamoorthy begin a decades-long campaign for accountability.

tt22297578.text: A former informant returns to undercover work to protect his younger brother. The assignment pulls old loyalties back into his life in Punjab.

tt15128068.text: A robotics engineer joins a scheme to cover up an affair. The elaborate plan starts coming apart as its participants begin turning up dead.

tt0081662.text: A professor repeatedly crosses paths with an itinerant friend. Music, desire and uncanny coincidences blur the boundary between the living and the dead.

tt0409459.text: The murder of a retired costumed hero sends Rorschach through an alternate 1985, looking for a connection among his former colleagues.

tt8396352.text: A villager reports seeing a tiger. With an election approaching, the story becomes as much a test of local politics as a search for an animal.

tt7430996.text: Two village children decide that keeping a fish alive will save a sick mother. Finding a safe home for it becomes their urgent shared mission.

tt1043876.text: A businessman receives demands for his kidnapped wife. A decision about the ransom draws him deeper into the mystery of her disappearance.

tt1981115.text: Jane Foster encounters an ancient force that attracts the Dark Elves. Thor returns to Asgard with her as the realms approach a rare alignment.

tt1300854.text: A series of bombings brings the Mandarin into Tony Stark's life. Stranded far from his workshop, he starts investigating with the tools he can find.

tt0458339.text: Rejected by the Army, Steve Rogers volunteers for an experiment that transforms his body. He takes his new abilities to the front against Hydra.

tt1843866.text: An attack inside S.H.I.E.L.D. puts Steve Rogers on the run. Black Widow helps him investigate an intelligence network guarded by a formidable assassin.

tt2015381.text: A stolen orb brings a thief, an assassin, two bounty hunters and a prisoner together. Their quarrel over its value gives way to a fight for an entire planet.

tt2395427.text: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner build an artificial intelligence to protect Earth. Ultron develops his own interpretation of what peace requires.

tt0848228.text: Loki's arrival on Earth prompts Nick Fury to assemble a team of heroes. Their first challenge is learning to work together before an invasion reaches New York.

tt2364582.text: Phil Coulson leads a field team investigating unusual technology, hostile organizations and people with extraordinary abilities.

tt3475734.text: In postwar New York, Peggy Carter secretly investigates stolen weapons for Howard Stark while working at the Strategic Scientific Reserve.

tt6313900.text: Elena Rodriguez uses her bursts of superhuman speed on a personal mission complicated by her commitments to S.H.I.E.L.D.

tt2357547.text: A private investigator with superhuman strength follows cases in Hell's Kitchen. A disappearance brings a figure from her own past back into her work.

tt3322312.text: Matt Murdock represents clients in court and patrols Hell's Kitchen after dark. His two lives bring him ever closer to crime boss Wilson Fisk.

tt3322314.text: Luke Cage tries to keep a low profile in Harlem. His extraordinary strength and bulletproof skin become public when violence reaches his neighborhood.

tt4230076.text: A conspiracy beneath New York brings Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Danny Rand together across their usual neighborhood boundaries.

tt5675620.text: Marine veteran Frank Castle follows evidence surrounding his family's murder into a conspiracy tied to his service.

tt0993840.text: A crew enters quarantined Las Vegas to empty a casino vault. They have to reach the money and escape a city overrun by zombies before a scheduled strike.

tt14458442.text: Peter welcomes his teenage son into the home he shares with his new partner and baby. He struggles to understand the distress behind the boy's withdrawal.

tt0098724.text: An old friend arrives with a video camera and a habit of recording intimate conversations. His visit unsettles a marriage already divided by an affair.

tt18291892.text: A Colombian domestic worker spends a summer tending to a wealthy family's holiday home. Her hours in the house reveal the terms of their apparent hospitality.

tt0181865.text: A judge, a Mexican police officer and a trafficker's family encounter different parts of the drug trade connecting the United States and Mexico.

tt1291580.text: Scott Thorson enters Liberace's household and becomes his lover. Their life together unfolds between the pianist's lavish home and his carefully managed public image.

tt0120789.text: Two teenagers are transported into a black-and-white television sitcom. As its residents discover desires outside the script, color begins to appear.

tt1124035.text: A press aide works the final days of an Ohio primary. An approach from the rival campaign forces him to reassess his candidate and his own ambitions.

tt0114746.text: Sent from an underground future to investigate a plague, James Cole arrives in the wrong year. A psychiatric patient and his doctor become part of his search for the outbreak's origins.

tt0114787.text: Friends running a wartime weapons operation in Belgrade retreat below ground. One discovers how easy it is to control what the others know about life above them.

tt0056801.text: A filmmaker prepares a costly production while struggling to decide what it is about. Memories and fantasies become inseparable from the film taking shape.

tt0060827.text: A nurse cares for an actress who has stopped speaking. In the isolation of a seaside house, their sense of where one identity ends and the other begins starts to falter.

tt0088846.text: A clerical error pulls a minor functionary into the machinery of a sprawling surveillance state. Pursuing a woman from his dreams makes him one of its targets.

tt0120601.text: A puppeteer discovers a passageway that lets people briefly experience the world through actor John Malkovich's eyes. He starts charging admission.

tt0119346.text: A newlywed discovers a growth on his neck can transform whatever he imagines. His marriage and the people seeking control of his powers complicate the discovery.

tt1013607.text: A belligerent man wakes with wings that seem to have a moral compass of their own. His efforts to rid himself of them draw unwanted attention.

tt0430159.text: An anxious dog's vivid imagination turns the harmless creatures along a walk into elaborate threats to its owner.

tt2361846.text: A collision at a bumper-car ride starts a romance. Jealousy and a fantastical body-swapping scheme threaten to undo it.

tt1284587.text: Kiarostami watches the faces of women in a cinema. Sound and their shifting expressions tell the story of the romance unfolding on the unseen screen.

tt0144736.text: Captain Harlock takes the Arcadia into space after an alien occupation of Earth. His crew searches for a place where people can live freely.

tt1410261.text: A man wakes in a blank room full of buttons. As he experiments with the objects they dispense, a wrestler in Mexico prepares for a match.

tt39395275.text: Earth has found peace after Majin Buu's defeat. The awakening of Beerus brings the destructive power of a god into Goku's world.

tt0214341.text: Goku and his friends defend Earth against alien warriors in this English-language Dragon Ball Z television listing. Gohan's growing powers bring the next generation into the fight.

tt0088509.text: Bulma's search for seven wish-granting orbs introduces her to Goku, a boy with extraordinary strength and very little experience of the outside world.

tt4644488.text: With Majin Buu defeated, Goku takes his training beyond Earth and meets gods and fighters from other universes.

tt0121220.text: Goku discovers the truth about his Saiyan ancestry. Battles on Earth and on Namek test both his strength and the abilities of his young son Gohan.

tt29485149.text: A wish shrinks Goku and his companions. Their quest to recover their adult bodies takes them into the Demon Realm.

tt7961060.text: An encounter with Broly brings Goku and Vegeta face to face with another survivor of their home planet and the consequences of their fathers' decisions.

tt1409055.text: This recut revisits Goku's Saiyan origins, beginning with the arrival of his brother Raditz and the revelation of a threat to Earth.

tt14614892.text: The Red Ribbon Army rebuilds in secret and deploys two new androids. Piccolo investigates while Gohan's daughter Pan becomes entangled in the plot.

tt0139774.text: Restored to childhood by a misplaced wish, Goku joins Trunks and Pan on a journey across space to recover the Black Star Dragon Balls.

tt0142242.text: A Saiyan survivor invites Vegeta to a new homeworld. There, a seemingly quiet warrior named Broly has extraordinary reserves of power.

tt10710138.text: This fan parody edits and redubs Dragon Ball Z, turning its battles, rivalries and lengthy transformations into a new comic storyline.

tt0142236.text: A breakdown in the afterlife lets the dead wander back to Earth. Goku and Vegeta must face Janemba at the source of the disturbance.

tt0142239.text: Broly awakens on Earth, where Goten and Trunks are searching for the Dragon Balls. Gohan finds himself facing an enemy from his childhood.

tt2263944.text: Beerus wakes from a long sleep with a dream about a Super Saiyan God. His search brings him to Earth during Bulma's birthday celebration.

tt0142238.text: A tournament gives Earth's fighters a chance to compete against visitors from space. Bojack and his crew turn the event into a real fight.

tt1125254.text: Cooler arrives on Earth looking for the fighter who defeated his brother Frieza. Goku's friends find themselves in his path.

tt8433216.text: Goku and Vegeta search for Trunks on a prison planet, where fighters from different points in Dragon Ball's history have been brought together.

tt0142244.text: Lord Slug lands on Earth and sets out to remake its environment. His search for the Dragon Balls brings him into conflict with Goku.

tt0142232.text: Goku Jr. ventures away from home in search of a Dragon Ball to help his grandmother Pan. The timid boy has to discover what he inherited from his famous ancestor.

tt0142237.text: A vast machine attaches itself to New Namek. Its inhabitants call for help, and Goku discovers that Cooler has found a mechanical route back to life.

tt0142243.text: Opening a mysterious box releases Tapion, a swordsman connected to a destructive creature. Trunks befriends him while the rest of the fighters investigate the threat.

tt3819668.text: Frieza's followers gather the Dragon Balls to resurrect their leader. His preparations for a rematch give Goku and Vegeta a powerful new opponent.

tt0142241.text: Three more creations from Dr. Gero's laboratory awaken and set their sights on Goku. A city attack moves the fighters into the Arctic.

tt0142251.text: Mining for precious stones has devastated King Gurumes's land. Goku and Bulma's first hunt for the Dragon Balls crosses paths with the kingdom's search for a cure.

tt2155428.text: An early English-language adaptation combines material from two Dragon Ball features into a single adventure following the young Goku.

tt9360062.text: Gohan Blanco rules the multiverse in this crossover parody. A rebellion brings characters from outside Dragon Ball into his orbit.

tt2565520.text: In this fan continuation, a new group of Saiyans arrives years after the battle with Omega Shenron. Earth's defenders have to respond while Goku is away.

tt32304483.text: A fan-made sequel to Dragon Ball GT sends the surviving fighters to investigate trouble on Namek after an unexpected summons.

tt0142234.text: A laboratory experiment creates a copy of Broly. Goten, Trunks and their allies confront the unstable result during Mr. Satan's visit to a rival.

tt0142248.text: A tournament takes Goku and Krillin to Mifan. The young fighters get caught up in the affairs of its emperor and the search for the Dragon Balls.

tt0142240.text: A scientist preserved as a living brain seeks a powerful new body. Goku enters his frozen stronghold to free the people being held there.

tt0142233.text: Invaders plant a tree that concentrates a planet's energy in its fruit. Goku must stop it from draining Earth to feed the Saiyan warrior Turles.

tt0142235.text: Garlic Jr. seeks immortality and takes Gohan along with a Dragon Ball. Goku and Piccolo find themselves fighting toward the same goal.

tt0142245.text: Bardock begins to see glimpses of the future. The Saiyan soldier races to warn his people about Frieza's plans for their planet.

tt1317478.text: A celebration at Mr. Satan's hotel receives an unexpected guest, Vegeta's younger brother Tarble. Trouble follows him all the way to Earth.

tt29954260.text: Trunks's son Vehan searches for the Dragon Balls with a new group of allies. Their wish could restore people lost to the super androids.

tt2980736.text: Displaced in time, Bardock encounters the ancestors of people he once knew and a space pirate whose visit pushes his Saiyan powers further.

tt0142250.text: This retelling returns to Bulma and Goku's first meeting, connecting their search for the Dragon Balls with a campaign against the Red Ribbon Army.

tt0142247.text: In a future devastated by androids, Gohan trains the young Trunks. Their lessons take place in a world where very few defenders remain.

tt27750841.text: This alternate fan storyline imagines Raditz surviving and raising a family close to his brother Goku. Domestic comedy shares space with martial-arts adventures.

tt21142804.text: The Ocean English dub gives Goku, his family and Earth's other defenders a distinct voice cast in their battles against Saiyan and interplanetary opponents.

tt0142249.text: Master Roshi sends prospective pupils Goku and Krillin to a castle in search of a sleeping princess. Both boys want to earn a place in his training.

tt21271842.text: A fan-animated reimagining sends King Vegeta on a mission from the Saiyan council. His journey leads him to Goku and a martial-arts tournament on Earth.

tt6866064.text: A behind-the-scenes companion to Battle of Gods turns the attention from the on-screen fighters to the performers who give them their voices.

tt4154664.text: A warrior lands in 1990s California during a conflict between the Kree and Skrulls. Clues to an earlier life on Earth lead her to question who trained her.

tt0145487.text: A spider bite gives Peter Parker new abilities. A family tragedy shapes how he uses them as the Green Goblin emerges in New York.

tt10872600.text: Peter asks Doctor Strange to restore his secret identity. A disrupted spell opens New York to visitors from other versions of his life.

tt2250912.text: While trying to prove himself to Tony Stark, a school-age Peter Parker discovers a local operation selling weapons built from alien technology.

tt22084616.text: Peter Parker works alone in a city that has forgotten who he is. Changes in his powers complicate his attempt to keep New York safe.

tt4154796.text: The surviving Avengers discover a way to revisit their past. Several teams must recover the Infinity Stones from pivotal moments in their shared history.

tt0081505.text: A family spends the winter caring for an empty mountain hotel. Their young son's visions expose a history that begins to take hold of his father.

tt0066921.text: A violent young man in a future Britain undergoes an experimental form of conditioning. His treatment raises questions about the freedom to choose.

tt0093058.text: A group of Marine recruits endures boot camp under a relentless drill instructor. Their training follows them into the streets of Vietnam.

tt10636154.text: A documentary considers Kubrick's final production and its place in his career, using Eyes Wide Shut as the starting point for a portrait of the filmmaker.

tt0072684.text: An Irish adventurer makes his way through armies, gambling rooms and aristocratic society in eighteenth-century Europe.

tt0062622.text: An ancient object on the Moon directs human attention toward Jupiter. Aboard the resulting mission, the ship's computer begins acting against its crew.

tt0056193.text: A professor rents a room in a suburban home and becomes fixated on his landlady's teenage daughter. His pursuit shapes the household's future.

tt0098936.text: FBI agent Dale Cooper arrives in a Washington logging town to investigate Laura Palmer's death. Her neighbors' accounts reveal a web of secrets.

tt0105665.text: The film follows Laura Palmer through the days leading up to her death, bringing the terror behind the town's central mystery into her own experience.

tt0166924.text: An aspiring actress helps a woman who has lost her memory after a car crash. Their search for a name takes them through a dreamlike Hollywood.

tt0460829.text: An actress starts work on a film with a troubled history. The distinctions between the role, the production and her life begin to dissolve.

tt0100935.text: Sailor and Lula drive away together after his release from prison. Her mother sends people after them, turning their road trip into a flight.

tt37361784.text: David Lynch and Naomi Watts revisit Mulholland Dr., offering perspectives from behind the camera and from the actor at the center of its Hollywood mystery.

tt0080678.text: A London surgeon brings John Merrick out of a Victorian sideshow. Life in a hospital offers him friendship as well as a different kind of public scrutiny.

tt0074486.text: Henry Spencer comes home to a newborn whose needs overwhelm him. His cramped apartment opens onto an unsettling industrial dreamscape.

tt0090756.text: A severed ear found in the grass leads a student to a nightclub singer. Watching her apartment draws him into a violent criminal relationship.

tt0116922.text: A musician receives videotapes of his own house. His story gives way to that of a mechanic, connected by a highway, a woman and an atmosphere of dread.

tt1619856.text: The television pilot that preceded Lynch's feature introduces a Hollywood newcomer and a survivor of a car crash who cannot remember her name.

tt0166896.text: Unable to drive a car, Alvin Straight sets out on a riding mower to visit his estranged brother. His slow route across the Midwest leaves time for encounters along the way.

tt2397535.text: A time-traveling investigator follows a bomber across several decades. A conversation with a stranger in a bar gives the case a startlingly intimate dimension.

tt16478058.text: College dance teams compete on the Bollywood circuit, where routines, rivalries and the pressure to win extend well beyond the stage.

tt13751694.text: A wealthy industrialist's son returns after an attempt on his father's life. His pursuit of the attackers exposes the cost of his fierce devotion.

tt0073650.text: In the final days of fascist rule in Italy, four powerful men imprison a group of young people in an isolated villa and subject them to organized cruelty.

tt0057012.text: A rogue order sends American bombers toward the Soviet Union. In the War Room, politicians and generals scramble to recall the planes before one reaches its target.

tt0286716.text: A laboratory accident makes Bruce Banner's buried anger physically dangerous. His father's experiments hold part of the explanation.

tt0800080.text: Bruce Banner searches for a cure while living under an assumed name. A military pursuit brings another, increasingly powerful opponent into the hunt.

tt0111161.text: Andy Dufresne arrives at Shawshank with a life sentence. His friendship with a longtime inmate named Red grows through years of institutional cruelty and quiet persistence.

tt0068646.text: An attack on Vito Corleone draws his youngest son Michael into the family's criminal business and the struggle over who will lead it.

tt0468569.text: Batman, Lieutenant Gordon and prosecutor Harvey Dent try to break organized crime's grip on Gotham. The Joker turns their alliance into a series of moral tests.

tt0167260.text: As armies gather at Minas Tirith, Frodo and Sam enter Mordor on foot. The hopes of both fronts rest on a journey almost nobody can see.

tt0109830.text: Waiting at a bus stop, Forrest recounts the American history he has wandered through and the childhood friend he has spent his life trying to reach.

tt1375666.text: A specialist in shared dreams accepts a job to plant an idea in an heir's mind. The deeper his team goes, the harder his own memories are to contain.

tt0137523.text: An office worker and a charismatic stranger begin holding bare-knuckle fights. Their clandestine meetings grow into an organization that outpaces its founders.

tt0080684.text: Luke seeks out Yoda after the Rebels flee Hoth. Han and Leia try to shake the Imperial fleet while Darth Vader prepares a trap.

tt0133093.text: A hacker follows a message to Morpheus and learns that the world he knows is an elaborate simulation. Learning its rules becomes a matter of survival.

tt0816692.text: With crops failing on Earth, a pilot leaves his children to join an expedition through a wormhole. Relativity makes time itself one of the journey's costs.

tt0114369.text: A veteran detective and his new partner investigate murders staged around the seven deadly sins. The killer's arrangement of the crimes becomes a message in its own right.

tt0102926.text: FBI trainee Clarice Starling interviews an imprisoned psychiatrist to understand an active killer. Every clue Hannibal Lecter offers carries a personal price.

tt0103064.text: A reprogrammed Terminator comes back to protect a young John Connor. He and his mother face a pursuer able to imitate nearly anyone.

tt0245429.text: Chihiro enters a bathhouse for spirits after her parents are transformed. To bring them home, she must find work, allies and a way to remember her own name.

tt0172495.text: Betrayed by the new emperor, a Roman general survives enslavement and enters the arena. His popularity in combat brings him within reach of the imperial family.

tt0253474.text: Pianist Władysław Szpilman survives the German occupation of Warsaw in hiding. Music and a series of fragile connections carry him through the ruined city.

tt6019206.text: This combined presentation follows the Bride's entire pursuit of her former assassination squad, from her hospital awakening to her meeting with Bill.

tt6751668.text: The Kim family secures a succession of jobs in the home of the wealthy Parks. Concealing how the new employees are related becomes harder as they settle in.

tt2582802.text: A young jazz drummer wins a place in an exacting bandleader's ensemble. Rehearsal becomes a contest over how much a player should endure for a great performance.

tt0482571.text: Two Victorian stage magicians compete to perfect a seemingly impossible illusion. Their search for its secret consumes their relationships and their lives offstage.

tt0114814.text: A survivor recounts how five men met in a police lineup and ended up at a deadly harbor confrontation. His listener must decide how much of the story to believe.

tt1853728.text: A German bounty hunter recruits Django and helps him plan a journey to the Mississippi plantation where his wife is being held.

tt0910970.text: A solitary trash-compacting robot finds a living plant on an abandoned Earth. A visiting probe takes him to the spacecraft where humans have lived for generations.

tt0209144.text: Unable to form lasting new memories, Leonard uses photographs and tattoos to investigate his wife's death. The film's backward-moving scenes give the viewer his uncertainty.

tt0361748.text: A Jewish cinema owner prepares a premiere in occupied Paris. A group of Allied soldiers has a plan of its own for the Nazi officers in the audience.

tt23849204.text: Manoj Kumar Sharma starts again after failing his school exams. His attempt to enter India's civil service takes him from a village classroom to the demands of the UPSC interviews.

tt1345836.text: Bruce Wayne resumes his life as Batman after eight years away. Bane's siege leaves Gotham isolated and forces its former protector to find a way home.

tt5311514.text: A Tokyo boy and a girl in a mountain town wake in each other's bodies. Notes left in phones and notebooks become their way of building a relationship across the distance.

tt33764258.text: Following the fall of Troy, Odysseus tries to bring his crew home to Ithaca. An encounter with a Cyclops is among the trials that turn a sea voyage into years of wandering.

tt0119698.text: A curse sends Ashitaka west to find its source. He discovers ironworkers clearing a forest whose animal gods are defended by a young woman raised by wolves.

tt0364569.text: Oh Dae-su is released from a private prison after fifteen years. Finding who held him means reconstructing the event that made him a target.

tt7286456.text: Arthur Fleck works as a clown in Gotham and dreams of becoming a comedian. Encounters on the street and on television give his growing anger a public audience.

tt0180093.text: Four people in Brooklyn stake their futures on dreams of success and escape. Pills and heroin steadily take over the routines through which they pursue those dreams.

tt0044741.text: A Tokyo public servant learns his time is short. A petition for a neighborhood playground gives him a chance to do something tangible with the authority of his office.

tt0338013.text: Joel learns Clementine has had him erased from her memory and arranges the same procedure. As their shared past disappears, he tries to hold on to it from inside his own mind.

tt0086250.text: Tony Montana arrives in Miami from Cuba and works his way into the cocaine trade. Wealth and power sharpen his paranoia about the people closest to him.

tt0105236.text: The survivors of a failed diamond robbery regroup in a warehouse. Unable to explain the police response, they begin investigating one another.

tt0986264.text: A boy struggling with reading is sent to boarding school. An art teacher recognizes his dyslexia and finds a way back into learning through the pictures he draws.

tt0120382.text: Small glitches in Truman Burbank's seaside town make him question the predictability of his life. Everyone around him has a stake in keeping him there.

tt0993846.text: Jordan Belfort builds a brokerage on aggressive salesmanship and fraudulent deals. An FBI investigation follows the stream of money behind the parties.

tt5074352.text: Former wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat begins training his daughters Geeta and Babita. Their pursuit of international competition changes what their village expects of its girls.

tt0372784.text: Bruce Wayne returns to Gotham with training acquired abroad. Building the identity of Batman brings him into conflict with the organization that taught him.

tt15398776.text: Physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer leads the Los Alamos laboratory during the Manhattan Project. Later hearings revisit his choices and the politics surrounding the bomb.

tt10272386.text: An aging man tries to make sense of his daughter's plans for his care. Rooms, faces and conversations seem to rearrange themselves around him.

tt0167404.text: A child psychologist tries to reach a frightened boy in Philadelphia. The boy's account of the people he sees tests the doctor's understanding of both their lives.

tt0477348.text: A hunter takes a bag of money from a failed drug exchange in Texas. A relentless hired killer tracks him while a sheriff follows them both.

tt0268978.text: John Nash develops a new approach to mathematics at Princeton. His work and marriage become intertwined with the difficulty of recognizing what is real.

tt0266543.text: A clownfish crosses the ocean with the forgetful Dory to find his son, who has landed in a Sydney dentist's fish tank.

tt5027774.text: Mildred Hayes rents three roadside billboards to press the police about her daughter's unsolved murder. Their message reignites divisions throughout the town.

tt1392190.text: Furiosa takes a war rig across the desert carrying women escaping Immortan Joe. Max joins them as the Citadel's vehicles bear down on their convoy.

tt0325980.text: Blacksmith Will Turner joins Jack Sparrow to pursue the pirates who have taken Elizabeth Swann. The missing piece of an old treasure links them to the crew's curse.

tt26548265.text: A barber arrives at a police station determined to recover something he calls Lakshmi. His baffling report is the entry point to an overlapping story of loss and revenge.

tt4430212.text: A cable operator in Goa devises an alibi to protect his family. The police begin testing their memories against the evidence of a disappearance.

tt1954470.text: Control of coal and a feud between families shape several generations in Wasseypur. Power passes down through business, politics and acts of revenge.

tt0903747.text: A cancer diagnosis leads chemistry teacher Walter White to cook methamphetamine with former student Jesse Pinkman. Their partnership changes both Albuquerque's drug trade and Walter's family.

tt7366338.text: The 1986 reactor explosion sends scientists, plant workers and emergency crews into a struggle to contain the fallout and establish what happened at Chernobyl.

tt0944947.text: Rival houses pursue power in Westeros. While their alliances shift, the Night's Watch faces a threat gathering beyond the northern Wall.

tt2861424.text: A scientist takes his grandson on hazardous trips across dimensions. The rest of the family deals with the consequences that make it back to their house.

tt1475582.text: Sherlock Holmes and army doctor John Watson share a Baker Street flat in present-day London. Their cases combine digital traces with Holmes's close observation.

tt0103359.text: Bruce Wayne patrols an Art Deco Gotham as Batman. Recurring investigations give the city's thieves and costumed adversaries stories of their own.

tt3032476.text: Public defender Jimmy McGill tries to build a practice in Albuquerque. His shortcuts, his bond with Kim Wexler and a growing connection to organized crime put him on the road to becoming Saul Goodman.

tt12392504.text: Stockbroker Harshad Mehta rides a surge in India's securities market. A journalist follows irregular bank transactions behind his rise.

tt0877057.text: Light Yagami discovers a notebook that can kill a person whose name he writes down. Detective L sets out to identify the unseen author of a wave of deaths.

tt0098904.text: Jerry, Elaine, George and Kramer turn the minor obligations of New York life into prolonged arguments about what people owe each other.

tt2356777.text: Each season follows a different investigation. The detectives' methods and private histories become inseparable from the crimes they are trying to solve.

tt0213338.text: Spike Spiegel and Jet Black chase bounties around the solar system aboard the Bebop. New passengers bring their own debts, skills and unfinished histories.

tt7660850.text: The adult children of media magnate Logan Roy compete for influence over the family company. A board vote or a birthday party can shift the balance between them.

tt4742876.text: Four friends leave salaried jobs to build a startup. Finding investors and agreeing on the direction of the company put their friendship to work.

tt3398228.text: A former sitcom star hires a writer to help with his memoir. Revisiting his history forces BoJack to navigate fame, addiction and the people still willing to answer his calls.

tt12004706.text: Engineering graduate Abhishek takes a government job in rural Phulera. The village council's daily business brings him into an unfamiliar network of friendships and local politics.

tt0072500.text: Basil Fawlty wants his Torquay hotel to attract a better class of guest. His elaborate efforts to impress visitors tend to make ordinary problems unmanageable.

tt0096548.text: Captain Blackadder looks for ways to stay alive in the trenches of the Western Front. Orders from headquarters keep confounding his plans.

tt2085059.text: Each standalone story follows people living with an invention, a media system or a social custom whose power becomes clear through the choices it permits.

tt2442560.text: Thomas Shelby runs a family gang in Birmingham after the First World War. Money from betting and stolen goods draws the family into national politics.

tt0434706.text: Surgeon Kenzo Tenma risks his career to save a child. Years later a series of killings raises a question about the boy he chose to operate on.

tt10986410.text: An American football coach moves to England to manage AFC Richmond. Building trust with the players becomes his first assignment as he learns the sport.

tt5753856.text: A child's disappearance links four families around a German town. Tracing their relationships sends the investigation back through earlier generations.

tt5687612.text: A London café owner confides in the audience while trying to hold together her family relationships, love life and grief for her best friend.

tt0804503.text: At a Manhattan advertising agency, Don Draper sells an idea of American life while concealing much of his own. The people around him find their roles shifting through the 1960s.

tt6025022.text: The Justice League recruits a much larger roster and coordinates missions from its orbiting headquarters. Smaller teams bring heroes with different powers into the same cases.

tt11280740.text: Employees at Lumon undergo a procedure separating their memories inside and outside the office. Mark begins to question who benefits from the division.

tt14392248.text: Three friends prepare for India's civil service examinations. Their relationships change as the years reveal where the same ambition has taken each of them.

tt0773262.text: Miami forensic specialist Dexter Morgan uses his knowledge of police work to conceal a second life, tracking and killing people he judges to be murderers.

tt4786824.text: The reign of Elizabeth II unfolds through private audiences, family disputes and changes of government that put different demands on the monarchy.

tt1518542.text: A wealthy Mumbai household navigates class differences in its own living room. Maya Sarabhai's standards repeatedly collide with her daughter-in-law Monisha's practical habits.

tt0096657.text: Mr. Bean tackles tasks such as taking an exam, going shopping or getting dressed. His almost wordless solutions usually make the job much more complicated.

tt1856010.text: Passed over for a cabinet position, congressman Frank Underwood and his wife Claire use their connections in Washington to build a path to greater power.

tt0088484.text: At the court of Elizabeth I, Edmund Blackadder competes for the queen's favor while trying to avoid the dangers that come with being noticed.

tt4574334.text: A boy's disappearance in Hawkins, Indiana, brings his friends into contact with a girl from a nearby laboratory and a world running alongside their own.

tt0275137.text: An alien threat brings seven DC heroes together. Their missions range from Gotham and Metropolis to conflicts that put the entire planet at risk.

tt0280249.text: This English-language television listing follows the young Goku's first journeys with Bulma. The hunt for wish-granting Dragon Balls introduces him to rivals, teachers and friends.

tt0487831.text: Jen takes charge of the basement IT department at a large company despite having little technical knowledge. Roy and Moss introduce her to the job on their own terms.

tt13868972.text: Homi Bhabha and Vikram Sarabhai develop India's nuclear and space programs. Laboratories, politics and their friendship shape the institutions they build.

tt4158110.text: Elliot works in cybersecurity by day and investigates people online at night. An underground group recruits him for a plot against a corporation at the center of his life.

tt9544034.text: Intelligence officer Srikant Tiwari manages counterterrorism investigations while explaining his frequent absences to a family that knows little about his work.

tt36988358.text: An alien visitor tries to cheer up a bullied schoolgirl with gadgets from Happy Planet. His limited understanding of her life gives every intervention consequences.

tt0112159.text: Shinji Ikari arrives in a fortified Tokyo to meet his estranged father. An attack forces him into the cockpit of a giant Evangelion before he understands what it is.

tt0290978.text: A film crew visits a paper merchant in Slough as management considers closing a branch. David Brent's attempts to perform for the camera unsettle his staff.

tt2575988.text: A new compression algorithm gives programmer Richard Hendricks a chance to found Pied Piper. The business of keeping it alive repeatedly collides with engineering it.

tt2359704.text: Successive generations of the Joestar family confront supernatural adversaries. New settings, fighting techniques and alliances carry the family struggle across time.

tt6161168.text: Ride with Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang as their camps move across a changing American frontier. Hunting, robberies and conversations around camp fill the space between missions.

tt2140553.text: Guide Joel and Ellie across an infection-ravaged United States. Scarce supplies shape when to sneak past enemies, craft tools or commit to a fight.

tt13258344.text: A parasite links a group of strangers and threatens to transform them. Build a party, negotiate with companions and use turn-based Dungeons & Dragons combat on the road to Baldur's Gate.

tt32591698.text: Lead a doomed expedition toward the Paintress in a fantasy world inspired by Belle Époque France. Turn-based commands combine with timed dodges, counters and aimed attacks.

tt2993508.text: Take monster contracts and follow Ciri's trail across war-torn kingdoms as Geralt of Rivia. Reading tracks, brewing potions and deciding whom to trust shape the hunt.

tt0184666.text: Guide Link through Hyrule at two ages. Playing melodies on the ocarina connects people, places and dungeon puzzles separated by time.

tt0208155.text: Cloud Strife joins a raid on a reactor draining the planet's energy. Materia lets the party combine spells and abilities as the pursuit of Sephiroth takes them beyond Midgar.

tt5838588.text: Kratos and his son Atreus cross the Norse realms to scatter a loved one's ashes. Axe combat and the boy's bow gradually become a shared language between them.

tt13119450.text: Fimbulwinter closes in as Kratos and Atreus search the Nine Realms for answers. Their choices about prophecy test the trust they built on the previous journey.

tt0180825.text: Solid Snake infiltrates the nuclear facility on Shadow Moses Island. Patrol routes, surveillance cameras and radio conversations are as important as weapons.

tt0365498.text: Naked Snake enters a Soviet jungle to rescue a scientist. Camouflage, food and field medicine bring survival into the series' stealth systems.

tt1568322.text: Glide across a walled-off district of Gotham as Batman. Detective work and stealth encounters link its rival criminal strongholds.

tt0210613.text: A fairground experiment sends Crono across time. Recruit allies from different eras and combine their abilities to change the fate of their world.

tt10562854.text: Explore the Lands Between as a Tarnished seeking the Elden Ring. Roads, caves and legacy dungeons let you approach its demigods with a character build of your choosing.

tt0183066.text: Leave a struggling village in search of a device that could restore its land. Turn-based fights and dialogue choices shape the trip through post-nuclear California.

tt0383385.text: Carl Johnson returns to Los Santos for his mother's funeral. Gang loyalties and pressure from corrupt officers send him across the fictional state of San Andreas.

tt0224637.text: Escape a mage's dungeon with a party of allies and explore Amn in pursuit of Imoen. Companions bring their own quests and arguments to the journey.

tt2103188.text: Switch between Franklin, Michael and Trevor as their criminal careers converge in Los Santos. Planning heists makes their different skills part of the same operation.

tt0374692.text: Gordon Freeman returns to a world occupied by the Combine. The gravity gun turns loose objects in City 17 into tools for puzzles and combat.

tt1648163.text: Chell wakes in the decaying Aperture Science complex. Paired portals, new devices and an uneasy relationship with its artificial intelligences guide the escape.

tt0282975.text: A letter from his dead wife draws James Sunderland to Silent Hill. Exploring its fog-bound streets reveals fragments of a history he has struggled to face.

tt1479962.text: Former outlaw John Marston is coerced into hunting members of his old gang. Ride between frontier settlements on both sides of the United States–Mexico border.

tt10471854.text: Link explores the sky islands, surface and depths of a transformed Hyrule. Joining loose parts into vehicles and tools opens up solutions to its puzzles.

tt3334704.text: Nathan Drake's brother returns with a lead on a pirate fortune. Following their childhood obsession takes them from crowded auction rooms to an abandoned colony.

tt25808274.text: V enters Dogtown after an aircraft carrying the president goes down. This expansion adds a walled district of Night City and an espionage story shaped by conflicting loyalties.

tt24179294.text: Sam Porter Bridges sets out on another expedition to link isolated settlements. Route planning, cargo management and structures left by other players change how each delivery works.

tt21047286.text: Leon searches a Spanish village for the president's missing daughter. This remake revisits the original rescue mission with revised encounters and a knife that can parry attacks.

tt1814884.text: Build a character and explore a province divided by civil war as dragons return to its skies. Learning words of power connects the main quest to ruins scattered across Skyrim.

tt1349460.text: Clues from Marco Polo's lost fleet send Nathan Drake after the Cintamani Stone. Climbing, gunfights and a moving train carry the hunt toward the Himalayas.

tt0397042.text: An assignment to find Ashley Graham takes Leon Kennedy into rural Spain. Over-the-shoulder aiming and a limited inventory give each encounter with the infected villagers a particular rhythm.

tt0314123.text: A deal goes wrong shortly after Tommy Vercetti arrives in 1980s Vice City. Building his own criminal operation becomes his route out of debt.

tt7651352.text: During the Mongol invasion of Tsushima, samurai Jin Sakai develops unconventional tactics to reclaim his island. Ride between villages, approach patrols in stealth or challenge them openly.

tt0291337.text: New York detective Max Payne follows the trail behind his family's murder. Comic panels tell the story between third-person shootouts that can unfold in slow motion.

tt1380179.text: A transfer student and his friends investigate murders in the rural town of Inaba. School friendships develop alongside expeditions into a world accessible through televisions.

tt3944082.text: Spend school days in Tokyo and enter distorted palaces as the Phantom Thieves. Relationships built in everyday life unlock advantages in turn-based battles.

tt0486673.text: A young rider crosses a forbidden landscape to bring someone back to life. Each of the sixteen colossi is both a moving opponent and a climbable puzzle.

tt0249174.text: Mario and Luigi travel a map of themed kingdoms to recover stolen royal wands. Suits such as the Raccoon and Frog change how the brothers cross each stage.

tt0221606.text: Explore Dinosaur Land with Yoshi and a flying cape. Hidden exits connect the platform stages to secret routes across the world map.

tt0263641.text: Link travels between two versions of Hyrule. Items discovered inside dungeons open new routes and reveal how a change in one world affects the other.

tt1282022.text: The Joker takes control of Arkham during a prisoner transfer. Batman uses detective tools, silent ambushes and close-quarters combat to retake the asylum.

tt1094581.text: A plane crash leaves you at the entrance to Rapture, a failed city beneath the Atlantic. Genetic powers and scavenged weapons help uncover the conflict that destroyed it.

tt1712064.text: Booker DeWitt enters the floating city of Columbia to find Elizabeth. Its skyline rails and her ability to open tears in reality reshape movement and combat.

tt4795016.text: Pursue the Lords of Cinder through the ruined kingdom of Lothric. Stamina, timing and the reach of each weapon shape combat between bonfires.

tt1541718.text: Choose an origin for a new Grey Warden and gather allies against the Blight. Pause party combat to issue orders as political choices divide the people of Ferelden.

tt0210061.text: A young woman with magical abilities becomes entangled in a rebellion against an empire. A large ensemble of companions gives battles and story chapters different perspectives.

tt0284110.text: Blitzball player Tidus accompanies summoner Yuna on a pilgrimage through Spira. Party members can rotate into turn-based battles as the group learns about the creature called Sin.

tt0846694.text: Stripped of his power, Kratos pursues the Sisters of Fate. Chained blades, platforming and puzzles carry him across the landscape of Greek myth.

tt1199781.text: Kratos scales Mount Olympus in his war with the gods. Combat and traversal play out across temples and the moving bodies of Titans.

tt10323784.text: Hornet finds herself captive in the kingdom of Pharloom. Her needle and silk support agile combat, acrobatic movement and a climb toward its citadel.

tt14321832.text: Two players guide Cody and May after they turn into dolls. Each chapter gives them a different pair of complementary tools to cross their oversized home.

tt0338221.text: Cab driver Tommy Angelo enters the Salieri family's orbit in 1930s Lost Heaven. Driving jobs give way to increasingly dangerous assignments for the mob.

tt1073668.text: Command the Normandy as Shepard investigates a rogue Spectre. Recruit a crew and make decisions in conversation as well as in squad combat.

tt1839558.text: With Earth under Reaper attack, Shepard moves between divided civilizations to assemble a fighting alliance. The fate of old companions runs through the campaign.

tt0217061.text: Build bases and command three factions in the Koprulu sector. Terran machinery, Zerg swarms and Protoss technology demand different economies and battlefield decisions.

tt22892938.text: Return to James Sunderland's search for his wife in a rebuilt Silent Hill. An over-the-shoulder view changes how its streets, apartments and hospital are explored.

tt5807780.text: Swing through Manhattan as an experienced Peter Parker balancing work, relationships and a new gang war. Gadgets and aerial movement link traversal to combat.

tt0282366.text: This expansion concludes the Bhaalspawn storyline. A high-level party confronts other children of Bhaal as their struggle engulfs cities along the Sword Coast.

tt3554580.text: Scarecrow's threat prompts Gotham's evacuation. Batman pursues him across the city with a drivable Batmobile while an armored commander counters his tactics.

tt1125798.text: Follow British SAS and U.S. Marine units through a linked military campaign. Multiplayer ties short objective matches to loadouts and progression.

tt0258523.text: Pursue a Dark Wanderer through several regions of Sanctuary. Character classes, skill trees and randomized loot give each journey a different build.

tt11177022.text: An amnesiac detective wakes in a Revachol hostel with a murder to solve. As he questions witnesses, competing parts of his own personality speak up in dialogue.

tt1073664.text: A resident of Vault 101 leaves shelter to find a missing father. The ruins around Washington, D.C. hold settlements, factions and clues about a water project.

tt0416779.text: Kratos serves the gods of Olympus and seeks relief from memories of his past. Athena offers him a final assignment against Ares in besieged Athens.

tt0366758.text: A murder investigation reunites Max Payne with assassin Mona Sax. Their intersecting accounts play out through comic panels and slow-motion gunfights.

tt8329350.text: Ori searches the forest of Niwen after being separated from the young owl Ku. New movement abilities turn earlier paths into routes to previously unreachable places.

tt1127708.text: A test subject wakes at Aperture Science and receives a device that creates two linked doorways. Momentum through the portals becomes the means of solving its test chambers.

tt8558306.text: Wolf, a shinobi sworn to a young lord, crosses war-torn Ashina to recover him. Sword deflections weaken enemy posture and a prosthetic arm opens routes through the terrain.

tt0296870.text: This StarCraft expansion continues the conflict after the fall of the Overmind. New units and shifting alliances change the campaigns of all three factions.

tt1800763.text: A clue connected to Sir Francis Drake sends Nathan and Sully after a lost city in the Arabian desert. Flashbacks reveal the beginning of their partnership.

tt1706601.text: A courier wakes after being shot and robbed near Goodsprings. Tracking the stolen package leads to competing powers fighting for the Mojave and Hoover Dam.

tt0802999.text: Niko Bellic arrives in Liberty City to join his cousin Roman. His hopes for a new life intersect with criminal debts and unresolved business from his past.

tt6057416.text: Cloud joins Avalanche in a much-expanded version of Midgar. Real-time attacks build the resources needed to issue spells, items and special commands.

tt7791150.text: An insect knight descends beneath Dirtmouth into the ruined kingdom of Hallownest. Hand-drawn caves, precise nail combat and newly learned movement skills reward exploration.

tt7896952.text: Teach one of three student houses at Garreg Mach Monastery. Lessons and relationships change how your students fight when rival nations go to war.

tt4044024.text: Aloy hunts mechanical creatures and searches for the origins of her world. Scanning a machine reveals components to target, detach or turn against it.

tt3983144.text: In 1988 Japan, Kiryu and Majima follow separate paths into a dispute over a tiny plot of land. Street fights sit alongside businesses and neighborhood diversions.

tt0413662.text: Guide a medieval civilization from a modest settlement through four ages. Resource gathering, research and army composition shape battles on land and water.

tt15174768.text: Engineer Isaac Clarke boards the damaged USG Ishimura in this remake. Cutting tools, zero-gravity movement and repairs become the instruments of survival aboard the mining ship.

tt2321297.text: A trip to the Rook Islands leaves Jason Brody's friends captive. Freeing outposts and learning the terrain give him a foothold against the groups who control the islands.

tt9459718.text: Zagreus tries to fight his way out of the Greek underworld. Each failed escape brings him back to a household of gods, relatives and rivals with more to say.

tt12496904.text: A blight drives Aloy toward the Pacific coast. New machines, underwater ruins and competing tribes complicate her search for a way to restore the planet's failing systems.

tt0884870.text: Play the sun goddess Amaterasu in the form of a white wolf. Brushstrokes drawn on the screen restore the landscape and alter objects in battle.

tt5238626.text: Androids 2B and 9S investigate machine life on a ruined Earth. Repeated journeys through the same conflict reveal new perspectives on both sides.

tt0217733.text: Choose a first Pokémon in Pallet Town, explore Kanto and build a team for its Gym challenges. Trading with a companion version helps complete the Pokédex.

tt0310011.text: Travel across Johto and raise Pokémon in a world with a day-and-night clock. Breeding and a new set of Gym Leaders extend the original collecting adventure.

tt1037854.text: Jim Raynor leads a rebellion from a mobile base. Between Terran missions, choose contracts and research upgrades that change the units available in battle.

tt0177266.text: Guide Mario through the Mushroom Kingdom's castles, pipes and underground passages. Running speed changes the arcs of jumps over gaps and enemies.

tt5370130.text: Characters from across video games share arenas where damage makes opponents easier to launch. Choose fighters, stages and rules for local or online matches.

tt6298000.text: Ellie travels from Jackson to Seattle after a devastating loss. A second playable perspective asks the player to retrace the conflict from the other side.

tt1699759.text: Ezio returns to Rome to break the Borgias' hold on the city. Recruiting and training assassins gives him allies he can call on during missions.

tt2739708.text: As Edward Kenway, sail the Jackdaw across the Caribbean. Naval combat and boarding actions fund upgrades alongside the conflict between pirates, Assassins and Templars.

tt5807606.text: Sam Porter Bridges carries supplies across a fractured America. Balancing loads and building paths with other players make crossing the terrain the central challenge.

tt1173898.text: Pick fighters from across Dragon Ball history for free-moving arena battles. Transformations, flight and energy attacks let duels move from the ground into the air.

tt1288501.text: Marcus Fenix and Delta Squad take the war against the Locust underground. Battles revolve around moving between cover and coordinating with squadmates.

tt0357718.text: The campaign follows both Master Chief and the Arbiter as the Covenant conflict reaches Earth and another Halo installation. Their missions tell the war from opposing fronts.

tt0259104.text: Four factions fight through the upheaval of the Third War in Azeroth. Hero units gain levels and carry items alongside the armies players build and command.

tt0462448.text: Climb Rockport's Blacklist to reclaim a stolen BMW. Rival races and police pursuits both contribute to the reputation needed to challenge the next driver.

tt2370518.text: Venom Snake builds a private army while undertaking open-ended missions in Afghanistan and Africa. Recruited soldiers and recovered equipment expand Mother Base.

tt0217729.text: Catch and train a team across Kanto, earn Gym Badges and challenge the Pokémon League. Blue's selection of wild Pokémon encourages trades with other versions.

tt0288740.text: This expanded Johto adventure gives the legendary Suicune a larger role. Time-of-day encounters and the Battle Tower give trained teams further challenges.

tt0478230.text: Travel through Hoenn as Team Aqua and Team Magma pursue conflicting plans. Beyond the league, the Battle Frontier tests teams under specialized rules.

tt2385021.text: Vault Hunters cross Pandora to oppose corporate ruler Handsome Jack. Class abilities and a huge assortment of guns support both solo and cooperative play.

tt0888006.text: Jimmy Hopkins tries to find his place at Bullworth Academy. Classes, errands, pranks and rival cliques structure the school day and the town beyond campus.

tt3810192.text: Build a mercenary named V in Night City, where a job involving a prototype chip goes wrong. Cyberware, conversation and combat offer different routes through its districts.

tt0277723.text: A betrayed getaway driver works for competing criminal groups in Liberty City. Driving between its islands connects missions to an open, three-dimensional city.

tt0217732.text: Begin in Kanto with Pikachu walking beside you. This version draws on the television series and lets the trainer meet the original three starter Pokémon during the journey.

tt0437437.text: The Prince sails to the Island of Time looking for a way to escape the creature pursuing him. Shifting between the island's eras changes the paths he can take.

tt12497042.text: Ethan Winters searches a remote settlement for his kidnapped daughter. Its four lords each control a different domain with its own approach to first-person horror.

tt12497014.text: A broken device sends Ratchet and Clank into another dimension. Rivet joins their fight against an emperor as rifts link planets and combat arenas.

tt0427889.text: Guide Sam Fisher through a series of covert assignments. Light, sound and carefully timed movements determine whether guards discover him or pass him by.

tt3856150.text: This live-action adaptation follows Sam Fisher early in his career, before the operative becomes established in the Splinter Cell program.

tt2224413.text: Infiltrate large outdoor compounds as operative David Jones. Reconnaissance and careful movement between buildings shape the approach to each objective.

tt0275393.text: Teams of attackers and defenders compete over bomb sites or hostages. Money earned in one round affects the weapons a team can afford in the next.

tt2584348.text: Five-player teams manage weapons and money across a series of short objective rounds. Map control and coordination decide whether a bomb can be planted or defused.

tt0466736.text: A sequence of Tour of Duty challenges adapts Counter-Strike's team objectives to play with computer-controlled squadmates and opponents.

tt7795464.text: Valve's Source engine rebuilds the classic Counter-Strike maps and round-based objectives. Teams still buy equipment before committing to a bomb site or hostage rescue.

tt2290962.text: Two teams draft heroes and defend opposing Ancients. Decisions about lanes, items and when to take a team fight change over the course of each match.

tt2071507.text: Teams of champions work through lanes and the surrounding jungle to reach the enemy Nexus. Each champion brings a different set of abilities to fights over objectives.

tt10987766.text: Race sanctioned events in Palm City by day, then risk the winnings in illegal night races. Police attention rises with the reputation earned after dark.

tt0790814.text: Recruit a crew and challenge rivals for districts of Palmont City. Canyon duels make position and restraint important on narrow roads with steep drops.

tt5108242.text: Drive the streets of Ventura Bay after dark. Custom builds, drift runs and races develop a reputation among crews with different ideas about driving.

tt0420798.text: Explore Bayview to find events, garages and rival racers. Tuning a car's appearance and performance is part of progressing through the underground scene.

tt2186922.text: Find cars parked around Fairhaven and enter them directly. Win events and challenge the Most Wanted drivers while using the city's routes to shake police pursuits.

tt1264900.text: An undercover assignment puts a driver inside an international car-theft operation. Highway battles and police chases link the races to the investigation.

tt7243342.text: Three drivers take on a criminal organization in Fortune Valley. Each specialist handles a different part of the racing, pursuit and heist missions.

tt1708432.text: Arcade races emphasize building nitro and taking the lead. The leading driver's colors and tags appear around the course as the field changes position.

tt0390296.text: Build and tune an import car for a nighttime racing circuit. Drag, drift, sprint and circuit events reward different approaches to driving.

tt1776254.text: Supercars chase one another along Seacrest County's roads. Switch between racer and police careers to use different pursuit equipment on the same routes.

tt2315506.text: This handheld Carbon spinoff follows a driver investigating the crash that killed his brother. A crew helps challenge rival racers for control of the city.

openlibrary:OL20033244W.text: Ryan Holiday looks at three moments when pride can get in the way of good work. He follows people starting out, succeeding and failing. Examples from sport, public life and business show how a willingness to learn changes each one.

openlibrary:OL19977665W.text: Ryan Holiday applies Stoic philosophy to setbacks. He separates what a person sees, what they can do next and what they may have to endure, then follows these ideas through historical examples.

openlibrary:OL16564458W.text: Drawing on his experience in publicity, Ryan Holiday follows rumors from small blogs into mainstream headlines. He shows how advertising incentives and reporting deadlines reward people who know how to plant a story.

openlibrary:OL1968368W.text: Robert Greene studies how people gain leverage over one another. Short accounts from courts, politics and conflict illustrate forty-eight tactics and the circumstances in which they can backfire.

openlibrary:OL1968364W.text: Robert Greene studies the roles people play when they want to attract someone. Historical courtships and literary figures become case studies in attention, anticipation and persuasion.

openlibrary:OL19761410W.text: Robert Greene looks for recurring patterns beneath conduct that can seem irrational, from envy to loyalty within groups. Each chapter uses examples to consider how those motives operate in the reader as well.

openlibrary:OL17429337W.text: Robert Greene follows the development of accomplished people across different fields. He traces the work between early curiosity and expertise, including apprenticeship, close observation and the decision to try something of one’s own.

openlibrary:OL16815225W.text: Nick Bilton reconstructs Twitter’s early years through the friendships, arguments and leadership struggles of its founders.

openlibrary:OL13806374W.text: Simon Sinek asks why some organizations inspire lasting loyalty. He examines how leaders communicate their purpose and what happens when their decisions drift away from it.

openlibrary:OL21691966W.text: DJ Carl Cox looks back on the parties, records and dance floors that shaped his life, from his early mobile DJ work to the international club circuit.

openlibrary:OL244537W.text: Attributed to Sun Tzu, this ancient Chinese text examines conflict through preparation, knowledge of an opponent and the costs of a prolonged campaign.

openlibrary:OL17917961W.text: Yuval Noah Harari turns to the pressures of the present, asking how people can make sense of technological change, nationalism and uncertainty in everyday life.

openlibrary:OL17590212W.text: Mark Manson argues that choosing which problems deserve attention is a more useful starting point for a good life than chasing constant happiness.

openlibrary:OL21526644W.text: Daniel Smith explores Einstein’s approach to thought experiments and his willingness to question familiar ideas, then considers how readers might apply those habits to their own problems.

openlibrary:OL15839737W.text: Rhonda Byrne introduces the self-help belief known as the law of attraction and describes how its followers use visualization in daily life.

openlibrary:OL3346506W.text: David Ogilvy draws on campaigns from his advertising career to discuss headlines, photographs, research and the work of running an agency.

openlibrary:OL19634712W.text: Simon Reynolds follows rave culture through its changing sounds and scenes, connecting the records played on the dance floor with the people who made and gathered around them.

openlibrary:OL27955361W.text: Music producer Rick Rubin explores the habits behind making art, from paying close attention to the world to recognizing when a work is ready to leave the studio.

openlibrary:OL20884418W.text: Vex King draws on personal experience to discuss self-worth, emotional habits and the influence of the people one chooses to spend time with.
